sources.quote: Start Up Energy Transition - The Global Innovation Platform Start Up Energy Transition (SET) is a global innovation platform supporting innovation in energy & climate tech for the global energy transition. SET is implemented with the conviction that a sustainable future is directly linked to innovative business models and political will. The SET platform is powered by the German Energy Agency (dena) . We support the global energy & climate tech ecosystem with our three pillars: The SET Award, the SET Tech Festival & the SET Spotlights (SET100 & Newsroom): The annual international competition for startups and young companies innovating for the global energy transition . In the last 10 years , the award has received more than 4.500 applications from more than 100 countries within 5 categories . Discover more Our annual one-day event bringing together innovators shaping the future of energy: the best startups in the field of energy & climate tech solutions, innovation-driven corporates , policy makers , investors , and public organisations leading the energy transition. SET Tech Festival Articles , videos , posts , insights , SET list & publications and events featuring news from the energy & climate tech world , the successes and challenges of SET startups and other trending topics valuable to the global energy transition.
